</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>33rd Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>反间计</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">(fǎn jiàn jì)</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: x-large;"><i style="color: #333333;">Let the Enemy's Own Spy Sow Discord in the Enemy Camp</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
<span style="font-family: inherit;">Another well known example from the novel 'Romance of the Three
Kingdoms' (cf. Stratagem 32), Cao Cao sent Jiang Gan (<span lang="zh-CN">蔣干</span>,
fl. 209) as an emissary to Zhou Yu (<span lang="zh-CN">周瑜</span>,
175-210 A.D.) of Wu, one of Jiang Gan's own former classmates. After
carousing for a while they both collapsed and dozed off. Zhou Yu fell
asleep, but Jiang Gan only pretended. He got up and rummaged through
Zhou Yu's desk, where he found a letter from two of Cao Cao's
generals discussing a plot to assassinate Cao Cao. On his return, the
generals were immediately beheaded. Of course the letter was a fake,
placed there by Zhou Yu [15].</span></span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Let
the Enemy's Own Spy Sow Discord in the Enemy Camp</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
is associated with the eighth hexagram, </span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Water
over Earth</i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">. Water
flowing over the open yin lines of the Earth can be an expression of
agency turned against itself. Another interpretation is that the yin
line in the second position is summoned to service by those above it
(the yang line in the fifth position, in particular). This second
line can be viewed as the reliable agent summoned to the opponent's
camp </span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">[1], [28]</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">.</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><b>VOCAB
LIST 33:</b></span></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section44" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to invite: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">邀请</span></span>:
	yāoqǐng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	party: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">派对</span></span>:
	pàiduì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to join/participate: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">参加</span></span>:
	cānjiā</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn136"></a></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">to sow discord/to invert:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">反间:
	fǎnjiàn</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
	  </span></span>
	</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	satisfied: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">满意</span></span>:
	mǎnyì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	what if...?: ...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">假如</span></span>?:
	...jiǎrú?   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	steep: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">陡峭</span></span>:
	dǒuqiào   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	add/plus:<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">加</span></span>:
	jiā</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	battery: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">电池</span></span>:
	diànchí   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	charger: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">充电器</span></span>:
	chōngdiàn qì   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to charge: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">给</span></span>...<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">充电</span></span>:
	gěi...chōngdiàn</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	disappeared: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不见了</span></span>:
	bù jiànle   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn141"></a></span><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">Zhou Yu:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">周瑜:
	zhōuyú</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	equal: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">等于</span></span>:
	děngyú   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	more than a hundred: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一百多</span></span>:
	yībǎi duō</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	less than a hundred: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一百不到</span></span>:
	yībǎi bù dào   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	as soon as possible (ASAP): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">尽快</span></span>:
	jǐnkuài</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	in the dark: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在黑暗中</span></span>:
	zài hēi'àn zhōng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	took a shower: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">洗了澡</span></span>:
	xǐle zǎo   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	in advance: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">提前</span></span>:
	tíqián   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	relieved: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">如释重负</span></span>:
	rúshìzhòngfù   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	toilet (seat): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">马桶</span></span>:
	mǎtǒng</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	(some/few) individuals: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">个别</span></span>:
	gèbié   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	to solve (a problem): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">解决</span></span>:
	jiějué   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	(difficult) problem: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">难题</span></span>:
	nántí   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	public shower/bathhouse: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">澡堂</span></span>:
	zǎotáng</span></p>
</div>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Sample Sentences 33:</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section85" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他们邀请我参加一个派对。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: They invited me to a
	party.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我要给手机充电，但是我弄丢了充电器。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I want to charge my
	phone, but I lost the charger.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请尽快给这个电池充电。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他对这个马桶很满意。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有个别人提前了一百多天到学校。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在黑暗中，他的笔记本不见了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一加一等于二。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">假如这座山太陡峭了，我们就不可以开车</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;上去。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    9)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">为什么很多人喜欢用反间计？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个难题终于解决了，我如释重负。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">
    11)
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">我昨天在那个澡堂洗了澡，只花了一百</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不到。</span></span></p>
</div>
